arabic_html:
وَٱصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ
وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِى ضَيْقٍۢ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ ۞
translation: And be patient, and your patience is not but through Allah. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire.
explanation_html: A quiet truth: Ibn Kathīr notes your patience itself is only by the help of Allah — the strength to endure is His gift, not yours alone. So even as you hold on, you are held.
